name: Beadframe
description: The lightest frame that still reads as one: a single thin rule round the cell.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { border: calc(2px * 6 / @size-col) solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
